value.purpose: Live track values and app rows; tabular digits, scales to 85% before truncating.

caption.purpose: Value captions, legend, scale labels, ruler, R/W markers.

motion.name: none
motion.purpose: Panel updates every 2 s without animation.

graph.rules: 1 device px; baseline 100%, now edge 60%, minute ticks 35% of separatorColor

components.name: Pressure Header
components.description: Verdict line: pressure dot, plain-words verdict, used % over swap.
components.html: Memory: normal67% usedSwap 713 MB
components.css: .ds-header{font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:312px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.85);} .ds-dot{width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:#34C759;} .ds-verdict{font-size:15px; font-weight:600; flex:1;} .ds-used{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-end; font-size:13px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.5); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-used small{font-size:10px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.5);}

components.name: Memory Composition Bar
components.description: 5 pt segmented bar: App in pressure color, Wired/Compressed/Cache in primary grays, legend below.
components.css: .ds-comp{font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; width:312px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px;} .ds-bar{display:flex; gap:1px; height:5px; border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(0,0,0,.1);} .ds-bar i{display:block; height:100%;} .ds-legend{display:flex; gap:6px; font-size:10px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.5); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap;} .ds-legend span{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px;} .ds-legend b{width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%;}

components.name: Track Row
components.description: Signature: label / shared-axis graph / value, 50-flex-84 pt columns, 40 pt tall. Mirrored two-way variant shown.
components.html: DiskR 9 MB/sW 10 kB/s1,2 TB free
components.css: .ds-track{font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:312px; height:40px;} .ds-track-label{width:50px; font-size:10px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.5);} .ds-graph{flex:1; height:40px;} .ds-track-value{width:84px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-end; font-size:12px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.85); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; white-space:nowrap;} .ds-track-value b{font-size:10px; font-weight:600; color:rgba(0,0,0,.5);} .ds-track-value small{font-size:10px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.5);}

components.name: App Row
components.description: Whole-row plain button opening Activity Monitor; quaternary rounded hover; busy CPU turns orange semibold.
components.css: .ds-app-row{font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:312px; padding:3px 6px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; font-size:12px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.85); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-align:left; cursor:default;} .ds-app-row:hover{background:rgba(0,0,0,.1);} .ds-app-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(0,122,255,.5); outline-offset:0;} .ds-app-name{flex:1; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;} .ds-dim{color:rgba(0,0,0,.5);} .ds-app-mem{width:64px; text-align:right;} .ds-app-cpu{width:40px; text-align:right; color:rgba(0,0,0,.5);} .ds-app-cpu.ds-busy{color:#FF9500; font-weight:600;}

components.name: Menu Bar Label
components.description: Pressure dot, memorychip symbol, memory %, cpu symbol, CPU %; monochrome symbols; figure-space padded tabular digits.
components.html: 67% 22%
components.css: .ds-mbl{font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:13px; color:rgba(0,0,0,.85); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-mbl-dot{width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#34C759;}

components.name: Quit Button
components.description: System push button, small control size; no custom styling.
components.css: .ds-btn-system{font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:11px; padding:1px 8px; border-radius:5px; border:0; background:#fff; color:rgba(0,0,0,.85); box-shadow:0 0 0 .5px rgba(0,0,0,.15), 0 .5px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.15);} .ds-btn-system:active{background:#e5e5e5;} .ds-btn-system:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(0,122,255,.5);}

narrative.overview:
One 340 pt panel, read top to bottom as a verdict, then a timeline, then the culprits. Every metric is a track on the same 5-minute axis, so a spike in one lines up with the others. The world is native macOS and nothing else: SF Pro, monospaced digits, semantic system colors, SF Symbols, AppKit separators. Depth, chrome and decoration are left to the system window.

Density is high but quiet. Color is spent only on data: one accent per track, and the pressure color wherever pressure is shown. All chrome is gray.
keyCharacteristics: Pressure verdict in plain words, before any number.
Four tracks share column widths and time ticks; the newest sample is always at the right edge.
Color means data. Text, rules and labels are semantic grays.
Fixed width, no scrolling, no animation.
Light, dark and increased contrast come from system colors, not custom palettes.

rules.name: The Color Is Data Rule
rules.body: A hue appears only where it encodes a metric or a pressure level. Chrome, labels and rules stay gray.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Track Rule
rules.body: Each track owns one system hue. A two-way track (read/write, down/up) uses the same hue for both halves, weighted by opacity, not a second color.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every changing number uses `.monospacedDigit()`. The menu bar label also pads with figure spaces (U+2007) to a fixed width so it never jitters.

rules.name: The Dash For Missing Rule
rules.body: Missing data renders as an em dash ("—"), never 0 or a spinner.

rules.name: The Window Is The Only Surface Rule
rules.body: No cards or inset panels. Groups are separated by space and hairline dividers.

dos: **Do** put every time series on the shared 5-minute axis with the 50 / flexible / 84 pt columns and 40 pt height.
**Do** use system semantic colors and SwiftUI text styles so dark mode and increased contrast come free.
**Do** give a new metric its own system hue and use it only in that track.
**Do** use `.monospacedDigit()` on every changing number and "—" for missing data.
**Do** keep text at secondary gray or stronger; legibility outranks quietness.
donts: **Don't** add cards, glass, materials, decorative gradients or colored borders.
**Don't** give a track a sparkline-in-a-section layout; tracks align, they don't stack as separate widgets.
**Don't** use a second hue for the other half of a two-way track.
**Don't** use tertiary gray for text a user needs to read. The build still does (Swap line, scale labels, "5 min / now" ruler, Apps column headers); that is a known defect, not a style.
**Don't** animate value or graph changes; the panel disables animations.
